$doc: §23.6 ST-4. 'A side broken' is the measured end: the Blue BASE OF FIRE (Blue Company 2, roster slot 1 - CompanyAttack's roles are slot 0 assault, 1 base of fire, 2 reserve; relabelled 2026-11-17, CE-8302) is destroyed within seconds of contact (all 90 slots down by 335 s at GAP 1500 / 335 s at 600), its HQ hears TaskFailed and reads it Black. It dies at ~290 m (335 s), on its way to its 250 m support position (CE-8302 moved that position from 100 m of the posts; this run is unchanged, golden SAME), so it never reports Set and the assault (Blue Company 1, Subordinates.0) is never committed; the reserve (3) waits at its 400 m stand-off, out of reach, for the 900 s deadline. After agg-backend's CE-8009 round of 2026-11-17 (personal weapons at the measured 0.4 rounds a man a second, hits through the body's zones, R-8005 re-fitted) the base of fire costs Red companies 1 and 2 five to nine men each (Green; it was ten or more - Amber - on 2026-11-16, R-8332), company 3 none (R-8345). The base of fire is down 5 at 329 s, all 90 at 346 s; it never reports Set, so the assault is still never ordered. The census is the HoldArea objective of ObjectiveCensus (a stochastic unit under a physical subject's roster counts its Present). ROWS
